claims.quote: The most frequent genetic cause of focal epilepsies is variations in the GAP activity toward RAGs 1 complex genes DEP domain containing 5 (DEPDC5), nitrogen permease regulator 2-like protein (NPRL2) and nitrogen permease regulator 3-like protein (NPRL3).

claims.object_text: genetically modified animal models recapitulating DEPDC5-related epilepsy
claims.quote: several genetically modified animal models recapitulate DEPDC5-related epilepsy
the benefit of rapamycin after withdrawal was less durable in Nprl2- and Nprl3-cKO mice compared with Depdc5-cKO mice.
